name: Disobeying Parents
overview: The Bible clearly commands honoring and obeying parents as a divine mandate, promising long life to those who do so (Exodus 20:12). Severe consequences are prescribed for those who strike, curse, or show contempt toward their parents, including death (Exodus 21:15, 21:17; Leviticus 20:9; Deuteronomy 27:16). This stern warning underscores the sacredness of the parent-child relationship and the seriousness of disobedience. Furthermore, Proverbs emphasizes the importance of early training in godly ways to ensure lifelong faithfulness, highlighting the role of parental guidance in shaping a child's character (Proverbs 22:6).
